command.goblinforest.info: Goblin Forest %s – 1v1 lane strategy with goblin clans.
command.goblinforest.help.hint: Use /gf help for all commands. Quick start: both run /gf join, then /gf start.
command.goblinforest.help.join: /gf join [red|green] – sign up for the next match, optionally choosing a clan
command.goblinforest.help.start: /gf start – start a match with everyone signed up (at least one player per clan)
command.goblinforest.help.practice: /gf start practice – practice match, even alone against an empty clan
command.goblinforest.help.stop: /gf stop – abort the running match (participants or operators)
command.goblinforest.help.reset: /gf reset – emergency: abort everything and bring all players back (operators)
command.goblinforest.help.controls: In a match: right-click hotbar items (slots 2–9) to cast spells and abilities, left-click a tower or stronghold to attack it.
command.goblinforest.help.keys: Keys: B war menu, Z/X/C/V slave/warrior/archer/assassin, U shaman, I wolf rider, O troll, M catapult.
command.goblinforest.joined: %s signed up for the next match (%s). Signed up: %s
command.goblinforest.match_running: A match is already running. Use /gf status to see the score.
command.goblinforest.need_both_teams: A real match needs a chieftain on each clan. To practice alone: /gf start practice
command.goblinforest.no_arena: The arena dimension is missing. Is the mod installed on the server too?
command.goblinforest.not_in_match: You are not playing in a match.
command.goblinforest.started: The match begins! You lead the %s.
command.goblinforest.starting: Starting a match with %s players, building the arena …
command.goblinforest.status.idle: No match and nobody signed up. Use /gf join to sign up.
command.goblinforest.status.lobby: Signed up for the next match: %s
command.goblinforest.status.team: %s (%s): fortress %s/%s, %s goblins, %s gold, reputation %s, chieftain level %s
command.goblinforest.stop_denied: Only participants or operators can abort the match.
item.goblinforest.kit.axe.desc: Left-click: attack enemies and enemy buildings
item.goblinforest.kit.fireball.desc: Right-click: fireball at the target, area damage
item.goblinforest.kit.healing.desc: Right-click: heals your goblins and chieftains in the area
item.goblinforest.kit.battleSlam.desc: Right-click: shockwave, damage and knockback around you
message.goblinforest.controls: You are the chieftain yourself: walk through the gate onto the battlefield with W/A/S/D and fight with left click. B opens the war menu, Z/X/C/V recruit, H switches stance, Page Up/Down zooms. Destroy the enemy stronghold!
message.goblinforest.forfeit_warning: The %s is no longer online. Without a return within %s seconds the match is lost.
message.goblinforest.hero_killed: Chieftain %s has fallen! %s gold for the %s.
message.goblinforest.match_error: The match was aborted due to an error. All items have been returned.
message.goblinforest.restored: Your inventory and position from before the match have been restored.
message.goblinforest.server_stopping: The server is shutting down, the match ends.
message.goblinforest.tower_destroyed: The tower of the %s has fallen! The %s gains +%s reputation.
message.goblinforest.purchase.population: No room left – upgrade your huts
message.goblinforest.purchase.unit_cap: Too many goblins on the field
stats.goblinforest.units: Goblins: %s recruited, %s enemies killed, %s lost, best soldier level %s
stats.goblinforest.economy: Gold: %s earned, %s spent, reputation %s, %s building damage
title.goblinforest.fight_sub: Lead your goblins through the gate into battle!
menu.goblinforest.title: War menu
menu.goblinforest.unit.warrior.desc: Tough, blocks frontal hits with a shield
menu.goblinforest.unit.assassin.desc: Stealthed, double first strike, hunts chieftains
menu.goblinforest.stance.advance.desc: The army marches down the lane to the enemy fortress.
menu.goblinforest.stance.hold.desc: The army stops and defends (or at the war horn's rally point).
menu.goblinforest.stance.retreat.desc: The army falls back to the fortress and heals there.
menu.goblinforest.upgrades.hint: Upgrades apply to all goblins of that type, including future ones.
menu.goblinforest.upgrade.tower.desc: More damage and range for the tower
menu.goblinforest.upgrade.walls.desc: More health for stronghold and tower
menu.goblinforest.spell.fireball.desc: Area damage at the target point
menu.goblinforest.ability.battleSlam.des: Free: shockwave with damage and knockback
command.goblinforest.help.keys2: H stance, N rally point, R bloodlust, G battle slam, Y rage, J fireball, K mushrooms, Page Up/Down camera zoom (all rebindable in Controls).
command.goblinforest.help.units: Reputation 2 unlocks shaman and wolf rider, 3 the troll, 4 the catapult. Goblins at level 5 (champion) gain a special ability.
item.goblinforest.kit.roots.desc: Right-click: enemies in the target area cannot move
item.goblinforest.kit.lightning.desc: Right-click: several bolts strike enemies in the target area
item.goblinforest.kit.meteor.desc: Right-click: massive impact that also hits buildings
item.goblinforest.kit.rage.desc: Right-click when charged: more damage, speed and lifesteal
message.goblinforest.enemy_rage: The enemy chieftain flies into a rage!
message.goblinforest.sudden_death_warnin: Sudden death in %s seconds: then both strongholds start to crumble!
message.goblinforest.purchase.no_ability: No ability points left (one per chieftain level)
message.goblinforest.purchase.not_charge: Not charged yet: fight to build up fury
title.goblinforest.sudden_death_sub: Both strongholds are now losing health
menu.goblinforest.rally_hint: Rally point [%s]: the army holds at the spot you are aiming at.
menu.goblinforest.unit.troll.desc: Huge brute, cleaving blows, wrecks walls
menu.goblinforest.unit.catapult.desc: Only attacks buildings, from long range
menu.goblinforest.unit.slave.tip:
Come in threes. Cheap fodder.
Champion: explodes on death, hurting nearby enemies.
menu.goblinforest.unit.warrior.tip:
Lots of health, blocks part of frontal damage.
Champion: protective aura, nearby allies take less damage.
menu.goblinforest.unit.archer.tip:
Ranged, benefits from the range upgrade.
Champion: shoots up to three targets at once.
menu.goblinforest.unit.assassin.tip:
Invisible until the first strike, which hits twice as hard. Prefers chieftains.
Champion: re-stealths after every kill.
menu.goblinforest.unit.shaman.tip:
Regularly heals the most wounded allies and attacks with curses.
Champion: heals more in a larger radius.
menu.goblinforest.unit.wolfRider.tip:
Fast. The first hit of every charge deals 50% more damage and knocks back. Prefers ranged targets.
Champion: charge recharges instantly after each kill.
menu.goblinforest.unit.troll.tip:
Huge health, barely knocked back. Hits enemies next to its target and deals 50% more building damage.
Champion: constantly regenerates health.
menu.goblinforest.unit.catapult.tip:
Ignores units and only attacks tower and stronghold, with splash damage.
Champion: fires two boulders per volley.
menu.goblinforest.upgrade.armor.desc: Less damage taken for this goblin type
menu.goblinforest.upgrade.attack.desc: More damage for this goblin type (shamans also heal more)
menu.goblinforest.upgrade.cannon.desc: Cannon on the wall: area damage against groups, stronger each level
menu.goblinforest.upgrade.training.desc: New goblins start one level higher (fighter, then veteran)
menu.goblinforest.upgrade.endurance.desc: +10% health and speed for the whole army per level
menu.goblinforest.spell.roots.desc: Roots enemies in the area for a few seconds
menu.goblinforest.spell.lightning.desc: Five bolts on random enemies in the area
menu.goblinforest.spell.meteor.desc: Huge impact, also hits tower and stronghold
menu.goblinforest.spell_upgrade.desc: Stronger effect (damage, healing or duration) for this spell
menu.goblinforest.magic.hint: Spells land where you aim. Right-click the hotbar item or use the key.
menu.goblinforest.ability.rage.desc: Charges in combat: more damage, speed and lifesteal
menu.goblinforest.ability.bloodlust.rank: Per rank: stronger and longer bloodlust, bigger radius, shorter cooldown
menu.goblinforest.ability.battleSlam.ran: Per rank: more damage, bigger radius, shorter cooldown
menu.goblinforest.ability.rage.rank: Per rank: more damage, longer duration, more lifesteal
menu.goblinforest.chieftain.hint: Every new chieftain level grants one ability point.
command.goblinforest.help.ai: /gf start ai [easy|normal|hard] – play against an AI clan (alone or together in one clan)
command.goblinforest.help.series: /gf start bo3 (or bo5) – best-of series; combinable, e.g. /gf start ai hard bo3
command.goblinforest.starting_ai: Starting a match against the AI: %s player(s) against the %s (%s, best of %s). Building the arena …
command.goblinforest.starting_series: Starting a best-of-%2$s series with %1$s players, building the arena …
command.goblinforest.unknown_option: Unknown option "%s". Possible: practice, ai, easy, normal, hard, bo3, bo5
message.goblinforest.round_result: The round goes to the %s. Score %s : %s (best of %s).
hud.goblinforest.leave_fortress: Walk through the gate onto the battlefield with %s
